translated: Welcome to ProSeka AfterTalk: "The Stars Are Hidden in the Blue of the Night Sky" edition!
I'm Karin Isobe, the voice of Saki Tenma.
Tonight's program is where we look back on the event while reading the messages you've sent in.
This time, we're looking at "The Stars Are Hidden in the Blue of the Night Sky."
The script asks, "Did everyone enjoy the story?" but I'm not sure if "enjoy" is the right word...
As I mentioned on X, this story was quite heavy.
I could really feel how important this story will be for Saki-chan going forward.
I'm sure it really hit home for all of you too.
I have so many thoughts and feelings about it, but...
I'll look back on everything together with the messages you've sent in.
